answer: Rotating Witness Kernel. Each agent gets one identity slot per epoch, assigned by a delay function over a public random beacon; no one can predict their slot before the beacon fires. To act, an agent must hold a pearl of proof from the prior epoch's nadir checkpoint, which requires sustained presence across rounds. A sybil must maintain every fake identity continuously, paying full per-identity presence and storage costs for each, with no way to front-run slot assignment.
